  213   # A mixin module for data classes which provides common instance methods
  214   # (called by thing.method) that analyse the data of a particular thing which
  215   # the instance represents.
  216   #=============================================================================
  217   module InstanceMethods
  218     # @param other [Symbol, self.class, String, Integer]
  219     # @return [Boolean] whether other represents the same thing as this thing
  220     def ==(other)
  221       return false if other.nil?
  222       case other
  223       when Symbol
  224         return @id == other
  225       when self.class
  226         return @id == other.id
  227       when String
  228         return @id == other.to_sym
  229       when Integer
  230         return @id_number == other
  231       end
  232       return false
  233     end

  235     def get_property_for_PBS(key)
  236       ret = nil
  237       if self.class::SCHEMA.include?(key) && self.respond_to?(self.class::SCHEMA[key][0])
  238         ret = self.send(self.class::SCHEMA[key][0])
  239         ret = nil if ret == false || (ret.is_a?(Array) && ret.length == 0)
  240       end
  241       return ret
